competitionFaqs::demo::0::a: To join a DEMO competition, click on the card of the competition and once inside click on the JOIN DEMO button. Joining a competition automatically creates a DEMO MT5 account and debits it with {{demoAccountInitialDeposit}}, you will be asked for a password. The account will remain READ ONLY until the start of the competition and trading will be allowed once the competition starts.
competitionFaqs::demo::0::q: 1. How do I join a DEMO competition?
competitionFaqs::demo::1::a:
In the Competitions area, you can see all the open and upcoming competitions for both Real and Demo Accounts. There, you'll find competition terms, start and end dates, as well as the 1st prizes.


If the competition is already underway, clicking the competition card will reveal more details, such as the rank and statistics for each participant.
competitionFaqs::demo::1::q: 2. How do I learn more about each competition?
competitionFaqs::demo::2::a: No, you can't rejoin a specific Demo competition that you've already participated in. However, you can join other Demo competitions.
competitionFaqs::demo::2::q: 3. Can I rejoin the same competition?
competitionFaqs::demo::3::a: No, all competitions participants are given {{demoAccountInitialDeposit}} in virtual funds once they join, and no top-ups or resets are allowed.
competitionFaqs::demo::3::q: 4. Can I top-up or reset my DEMO account balance?
competitionFaqs::demo::4::a:
Performance is calculated using the following formula:



EquityCurrent = Your equity at every evaluation point, typically every 10 minutes


EquityInitial = Your equity at the point of entering the competition


D = Deposits that have taken place after joining the competition


W = Withdrawals that have taken place after joining the competition


Your performance determines your ranking in relation to other competitors
competitionFaqs::demo::5::a: No, all Demo competitions can be joined with MT5 accounts. You don't need to have an existing Demo Account; one will be created for you upon joining the competition.
competitionFaqs::demo::5::q: 6. Can I use an MT4 account?
competitionFaqs::demo::6::a: Yes, you are free to use an expert advisor if you so wish.
competitionFaqs::demo::6::q: 7. Can I use an Expert Advisor?
competitionFaqs::demo::7::a: Ranking is calculated based on the performance of all competitors. At every calculation interval (typically every 10 minutes), the performance of all competitors is calculated and then sorted in descending order. The higher the performance, the higher the ranking. Competitors with zero performance due to no trading activity are displayed during the competition but are excluded from the prizes.
competitionFaqs::demo::8::a: In cases where competitors share the same ranking, they receive an equal share of the prize for that position.
competitionFaqs::demo::8::q: 9. What happens if two competitors have the exact same performance?
competitionFaqs::demo::9::a: To see the results of a competition that has ended, click the 'Ended' button and find the respective competition. For ongoing competitions, the results are displayed on the dashboard where all the statistics are shown.
competitionFaqs::demo::9::q: 10. Where can I see the results of a competition?
competitionFaqs::demo::10::a: In the context of demo competitions, Stop Out is the level at which a competitor is excluded from the competition. It’s calculated as a percentage of the highest point of performance (max equity). For example, if the percentage is 30% and the maximum equity is $2,000, then the Stop Out will be $1,400. If the current equity drops below the Stop Out level, the competitor will be excluded. For the competitors’ convenience, the Stop Out level is displayed on their respective performance charts.
competitionFaqs::demo::11::a: Account leverage depends on the competition; it is set at the same level for all participants and cannot be changed, e.g., 100 or 500
competitionFaqs::real::0::a: To enter a competition, first select the account you'll use to participate from the slider on the left-hand side. You'll see all your accounts on that slider and switching through them will automatically show you whether the account you've selected meets the requirements of the competition you want to join.
competitionFaqs::real::0::q: 1. How do I enter a competition?
competitionFaqs::real::1::a:
In the competition area you can see all the open and upcoming competitions for both Real and Demo accounts.


In the card of the competition you’ll find the competition terms, the start and end date as well as the 1st prize.


If the competition’s already underway, clicking on the competition card will also reveal more detailed information like the statistics for each participant in the competition.
competitionFaqs::real::1::q: 2. How do I learn more about each competition?
competitionFaqs::real::2::a: Yes. You can enter multiple competitions at the same time with different accounts, assuming these accounts meet the competition’s requirements. However, each individual account can ONLY enter one competition at a time.
competitionFaqs::real::2::q: 3. Can I enter many competitions at the same time?
competitionFaqs::real::3::a:
Performance is calculated using the following formula:



EquityCurrent = Your equity at every evaluation point, typically every 10 minutes


EquityInitial = Your equity at the point of entering the competition


D = Deposits that have taken place in the period after joining the competition


W = Withdrawals that have taken place in the period after joining the competition


Your performance determines your ranking in relation to other competitors.
competitionFaqs::real::4::a: Your performance is NOT positively or negatively affected by any withdrawals you make in your trading account.
competitionFaqs::real::4::q: 5. What happens to my performance if I make a withdrawal?
competitionFaqs::real::5::a: The reset button offers users the possibility to effectively rejoin the competition with zero performance assuming they meet the Entry Requirements. The reset button is visible below a certain threshold of performance, for example less than -30%
competitionFaqs::real::6::a: Competitions are available to both MT4 and MT5 accounts and you are free to use an expert advisor if you wish.
competitionFaqs::real::6::q: 7. Can I use MT4 account or expert advisor?
competitionFaqs::real::7::a: Yes you can. Performance is calculated based on net equity changes so the P&L of existing open trades is ignored. Change to the P&L in open positions after entering a competition are taken into consideration in the competitors performance.
competitionFaqs::real::7::q: 8. Can I enter a competition with existing open (winning or losing) trades?
competitionFaqs::real::8::a: Ranking is calculated based on the performance of all competitors. At every calculation interval (typically every 10 minutes) the performance of all competitors is calculated and subsequently sorted in descending order. The higher the performance the higher the ranking. Competitors with zero performance due to no trading activity are displayed during the duration of the competition but are excluded from the prizes.
competitionFaqs::real::9::a: In cases where the competitors share the same ranking, they split the prize for that position.
competitionFaqs::real::9::q: 10. What happens if two competitors have the exact same performance?
competitionFaqs::real::10::a: To see the results of a competition that has ended, click on the ended button and find the respective competition. For ongoing competitions, the results are displayed in the relevant area as explained in the statistics topic.
competitionFaqs::real::10::q: 11. Where can I see the results of a competition?
competitionFaqs::real::11::a:
The following performance chart shows a competitor’s performance since entering a competition.



The competitor rankings show:

  • Rank
  • Change of rank since previous day
  • The competitor’s country and nickname
  • Trading account performance since entering competition


The ranking chart is calculated daily, and shows the competitor’s historical ranking since joining the competition. It is green when positive and red when negative



The Top Positions pie chart shows:

  • The top 3 winning symbols
  • The top 3 losing symbols
  • The top 3 most traded symbols

The positions table shows all open and closed trades as of the last evaluation period. An indicative profit is calculated for open positions based on prevailing prices.


The Competitor's Chart shows the number of competitors participating in the competition and it’s calculated at every evaluation point.


The top improvers table shows the competitors who have improved in terms of ranking since the previous day. More specifically it shows the competitor’s:


  • Country
  • Nickname
  • Ranking as of last night
  • Ranking as of last evaluation
  • Improvement in terms of ranking

competitions::tiers::daily_challenge::de:
Participation eligibility

  • KYC verified status.
  • Real MT4 / MT5 Account.
  • Account type {{accountType}}.
  • Equity over{{equity}} at time of joining competition.

General Rules

  1. The client can participate in a competition with one account only, at any time.
  2. The ranking is based on the performance of the account which excludes any withdrawals that happen on the account during its participation time.
  3. The prizes are all cash and will be deposited in the account which entered the competition shortly after the Competition’s end time.
  4. A withdrawal during the competition can lead to exclusion from the competition if remaining equity, after withdrawal, is less than the competition’s tier equity threshold.
  5. Participation in the competition means that competitors agree to publishing their trading activity and trading history.
  6. The Company reserves the right to refuse any person as a competitor.
  7. The Company reserves the right to Amend the Rules at any time including, but not limited to, the competition duration.
  8. The use of Expert Advisors is allowed as long as they are not used in a way that breeches the general rules and calls for disqualification.
  9. The company has sole discretion to disqualify any account from the competition, if it believes the account has acted in a deceitful manner or gained an unfair advantage.
  10. The full Terms and Conditions of the competition can be found here: Terms and Conditions
competitions::tiers::daily_challenge::ov: The Daily Challenge awards cash prizes to the Top {{numberOfPrizes}} highest ranked accounts over the competition period. Ranking is determined by account performance from the time of joining to the end of the competition. You can enter at any point during the competition or prior to the competition start.
competitions::tiers::demo_seven_day_show:
Participation eligibility

  • KYC verified status.

General Rules

  1. The client can participate in a DEMO competition only ONCE at a time, meaning that if a DEMO competition is in progress for however long that might be, the participant can only partake once.
  2. The ranking is based on the performance of the account.
  3. A new DEMO account is created once you join; the MT5 account and hostname are provided, and the user chooses the password for the MT5 account.
  4. All DEMO accounts get debited with a {{demoAccountInitialDeposit}} which cannot be topped up, reset, or withdrawn. Accounts remain on READ-ONLY until the competition starts and get archived shortly thereafter.
  5. The user has to download the MT5 application on PC or mobile and use the above credentials.
  6. The prizes are all cash and will be deposited in an XM trading account of the winner. An XM representative will be in contact with the winner within 2 working days after the competition's end.
  7. Participation in the competition means that competitors agree to publishing their trading activity and trading history.
  8. The Company reserves the right to refuse any person as a competitor.
  9. The Company reserves the right to amend the Rules at any time, including, but not limited to, the competition duration.
  10. The use of Expert Advisors is allowed as long as they are not used in a way that breaches the general rules and calls for disqualification.
  11. The company has sole discretion to disqualify any account from the competition if it believes the account has acted in a deceitful manner or gained an unfair advantage.
  12. The full Terms and Conditions of the competition can be found here: Terms and Conditions

faqs::0::a:
Before you can follow a strategy, you’ll need an Investor Account.

You can open one via the Members Area once your trading account is verified. Simply click the ‘Create Investor’ button in the top right and your account will be created automatically.
faqs::0::q: 1. How do I follow a strategy?
faqs::1::a:
Investor Accounts are denominated in USD, feature leverage of {{investorLeverage}} and they can open as little as 0.001 lots of Forex and Gold. They can be used to trade micro lots and offer the same spreads and swaps as our {{investorAccountType}} Accounts.

They act like digital wallets, accessible on web and mobile. You can’t place trades with an Investor Account, and you won’t need a password when logging in.
faqs::1::q: 2. What are the key features of Investor Accounts?
faqs::2::a:
There is a requirement of minimum $100 across {{company}} accounts in order to create a strategy.

Creating a strategy is simple, just go to our Copy Trading platform and click on the ‘Strategy Manager’ button, then click ‘Create Strategy’. Fill in the details for your trading account and then click next. On the next screen fill the strategy details and optionally set a password for you strategy. Also optionally you can select if you want to import history from one of your existing {{company}} accounts.

Your strategy will only be visible to Investors if it has more than $50 of equity in it.
faqs::2::q: 3. How do I create a strategy?
faqs::3::a:
Upon creation of a strategy the manager can choose whether to receive the performance fees in his wallet or the strategy trading account; the wallet is chosen as default, however the manager can change it at any time in the future in the manager area.

Fees are calculated using the High-Water mark model, demonstrated in the chart below.

They are calculated and paid on a daily basis taking into consideration both realised and unrealised profit. If the trade is profitable and the amount is above the previous high watermark, the fee is deducted from the Investor’s account and credited to the Strategy Manager’s account.

Strategy Managers receive fees in their account currency. If this is different to the Investor’s account currency, the amount will be converted automatically at the prevailing market price.

If an Investor closes a trade before the Strategy Manager and the position meets the criteria, the fee will be charged and credited to the Provider’s account within 30 minutes.

A Strategy Manager can choose to receive any performance fees, paid by Investors, in their {{company}} Wallet or their Strategy trading account (MT4 or MT5). The manager can change this setting later in the Manager Area. Changing this setting affects only future fees not already paid ones.
faqs::4::a:
You can update your trader bio, social handle, and preferred language in the Settings section.

Your trader bio appears alongside your strategies and is an opportunity to tell the community a little about your experience.

Your social handle is automatically assigned by default, however, you can change this, as long as the desired handle doesn’t already exist.

Once a preferred language is chosen, the platform will automatically load in said language until you change this setting again.
faqs::4::q: 5. How do I update my account information?
faqs::5::a:
Yes, as a Strategy Manager, you can create strategies from both MT4 and MT5 accounts and publish them for Investors to follow.

Investor Accounts are only accessible from our web platform or on mobile.
faqs::5::q: 6. Is Copy Trading compatible with MT4 and MT5?
faqs::6::a: As with all types of investing, there is a certain degree of risk. You can lose more than your invested capital if the market moves unfavourably. Although the risk can be managed with tools like Stop Loss levels, there’s no guarantee any losses won’t exceed the limit set.
faqs::7::a:
When you copy open positions, trades that a Strategy Manager has already placed will be opened for you. These positions will be opened at the prevailing market price.

If any of the positions are on markets that are not in session at the time of copying, the orders will be executed once the markets open.

Keep in mind that ‘Copy Open Trades’ is not enabled by default, so, you will have to activate it.
faqs::7::q: 8. What happens when I copy open positions?
faqs::8::a:
As an Investor, you can pause a strategy you’re following at any time. Once paused, no new positions will be opened. However, any positions subsequently closed by the Strategy Manager will be reflected on your account.

You can also resume or exit paused strategies. If you choose to resume a strategy, any positions opened by the Provider going forward will be reflected. Positions opened when the strategy was paused will be ignored. When exiting a strategy, market orders are placed to close all positions related to said strategy. All positions will be closed at the prevailing market rates. For positions on markets that are not in session, the orders will be placed once the markets open.
faqs::8::q: 9. What happens when I pause or exit a strategy?
faqs::9::a: As with all our other account types, you can deposit funds via the Members Area, either via direct deposit or internal transfer from one of your other accounts.
faqs::9::q: 10. How do I fund my Investor Account?
faqs::10::a:
Investment Amount

When subscribing to a Strategy, depending on the Investment Amount, the Multiplier will be calculated as follows:

The Investor’s Volume will be calculated as follows:

The Multiplier will automatically adjust whenever there is a balance transaction on the Manager’s account to maintain the proportionality of Investment Amount versus the Manager’s new equity.

Example:

Investor with $1,000 equity in his account allocates $1,000 to a Strategy, both Investor and Manager leverage are 500. The Multiplier is calculated as 1, meaning that the Investor will open positions with the same volume as that of the Manager. A few minutes later the Manager deposits an extra $1,000 in his account bringing his total equity to $2,000, in this case the Multiplier for the subscription is updated automatically from 1 to 0.5, meaning that if the Manager opens 1 lot the Investor will open 0.5 lots.



Fixed Multiplier

A fixed multiplier is selected by the Investor, and it shall remain fixed for the duration of the subscription to the Strategy.


The Investor’s Volume will be calculated as follows:

The Fixed Multiplier shall remain the same regardless of balance transactions taking place in the Manager’s account.

Example:

Investor with $1,000 equity in his account chooses to use Fixed Multiplier of 1 to a Strategy with $1,000 equity. The Investor will open positions with the same volume as that of the Manager. A few minutes later the Manager deposits an extra $1,000 in his account, bringing his total equity to $2,000. The Investor will continue to open positions with the same volume as that of the manager (assuming that he has enough free margin).


IMPORTANT NOTE

When an Investor chooses to allocate to a strategy using Investment Amount, a stop loss is automatically set, in the background, equal to the Investment Amount. If Investor chooses a different stop loss it overrides the one set automatically.


When an Investor chooses to allocate to a strategy using Fixed Multiplier, no stop loss is set automatically, the Investor can set his own.

Multiplier Details

The Minimum Investor Volume for Forex and Gold is 0.001, if the Investor Volume calculated is less than 0.001, no action will be taken. (Example 1)

In all other assets such as Futures, Crypto, Indices the Minimum Investor Volume is 0.01, if the Investor Volume is less than 0.01 then the Investor volume will be 0.01 (or other applicable minimum size). (Example 2)

Example:

Example 1: Multiplier = 0.05 and Manager Buys 0.01 lots of Gold, Investor Volume = 0.0005, given that this is below Minimum Investor Volume no position will be opened for Investor.


Example 2: Multiplier = 0.05 and Manager Buys 0.1 lots of GER40, Investor Volume = 0.05, given that this is below Minimum Investor Volume and its an Index the Investor will buy 0.1 lots of GER40.
faqs::10::q: 11. What happens after I follow a Strategy?
faqs::11::a:
Here are a few things to keep in mind when it comes to our Copy Trading Platform:


Strategy Managers

  • You can open up to 10 Strategy Manager Accounts.
  • There is no follower cap for strategies. Each strategy can be followed by an unlimited number of Investors
  • You can set commission as high as 50% of your followers’ profits
  • There is no commission cap. The more Investors that follow, and the more successful the strategy is, the more you can earn

Investors

  • You will receive a margin call at 50% and be stopped out at 20%. These can be seen clearly on the progress bar on the Copy Trading platform
  • There is a limit of only 1 Investor Account per client. But you can follow unlimited strategies, as long as you have the equity available
  • Stock CFDs are not currently available on Investor Accounts, although we may introduce them later. As such, when Strategy Managers open positions on Stock CFDs, these will not be reflected on your Investor Account
  • If you have an Islamic trading account, your Investor Account will automatically be an Islamic account as well
  • The minimum amount needed to start copying a strategy is $50. However, each strategy also has a minimum investor amount, as set by the Provider, which may be above $50

General

  • You can be both an Investor and a Strategy Manager
  • We don’t offer Demo Accounts for the Copy Trading platform
  • The Featured list is decided by the Company at its sole discretion
  • The Best Performers list is sorted in descending order
  • The Most Popular list is sorted by number of investors, in descending order
  • Strategies are automatically included in categories based on their exposure. This is calculated hourly and requires at least 40% exposure in any category to be included
faqs::11::q: 12. Are there any rules, restrictions, or limits to the Copy Trading Platform?
faqs::12::a:
The Strategy Manager section of our Copy Trading platform is designed to provide an overview of all a Provider’s strategies and performance statistics.


Key statistics measured include:

  • Total number of followers per strategy (active, paused, and exited)
  • Top and worst performing trades
  • Asset allocation per asset class
  • Trading frequency
  • A detailed ledger of all commission received

profile::socialPointsInfo::title: Social Points
profile::socialPointsInfo::content:
Copy Trading

The Copy Trading Social Points system is designed to reward strategy managers based on their total invested amount, the number of active strategies they manage, and the total number of active investors. Here's how the points are calculated:

Formula:

Copy Trading Social Points = Investment Amount + (Total Active Strategies * 10) + (Active Investors * 100)

Components:
  • Investment Amount: The total amount of money invested across all active strategies.
  • Total Active Strategies: The number of strategies currently being managed.
  • Active Investors: The total number of investors across all active strategies.
Ranks:
  • LEGEND: Social Points >= 10,000
  • EXPERT: Social Points >= 1,000 and Social Points < 10,000
  • EXPERIENCED: Social Points >= 50 and Social Points < 1,000
  • AMATEUR: Social Points < 50
Example Calculation:

Let's say a strategy manager has the following active strategies:

  1. Strategy A:
    • Investors: 20
    • Invested Amount: $19,000
  2. Strategy B:
    • Investors: 1
    • Invested Amount: $1,000
  3. Strategy C:
    • Investors: 430
    • Invested Amount: $230,000
Step-by-Step Calculation:
  1. Total Investment Amount:19,000+1,000+230,000=250,000
  2. Total Active Strategies: 3
  3. Total Active Investors: 20+1+430 =451
  4. Social Points Calculation: 250,000+(3x10)+(451x100)
    • Investment Amount Component: 250,000
    • Active Strategies Component: 3x10=30
    • Active Investors Component: 451x100=45,100
    • Total Social Points: 295,130
Competitions

The Competition Social Points system rewards users based on their participation and success in competitions. Users earn points based on the prizes they win or, if they do not win, they receive points for their participation.

Points Calculation:
  • Prize Won: If a user wins a prize in a competition, they receive points equal to the prize amount.
  • No Prize Won: If a user does not win a prize, they receive points equal to half of the smallest prize in that competition.
Ranks:
  • LEGEND: Social Points >= 5,000
  • EXPERT: Social Points >= 1,000 and Social Points < 5,000
  • EXPERIENCED: Social Points >= 50 and Social Points < 1,000
  • AMATEUR: Social Points < 50
Example Calculation:

Let's say a user participated in the following three competitions:

  1. Competition A:
    • Minimum Prize: $10
    • User Rank: 200th
    • Prize Won: $0

    Since the user did not win a prize, they receive half of the smallest prize: 10/2= 5

  2. Competition B:
    • Minimum Prize: $25
    • User Rank: 1st
    • Prize Won: $100

    Since the user won a prize, they receive the prize amount: 100

  3. Competition C:
    • Minimum Prize: $10
    • User Rank: 15th
    • Prize Won: $10

    Since the user won a prize, they receive the prize amount: 10

Total Competition Social Points: 5+100+10=115
